During his career he has been fortune to work with numerous top teachers across the country including Michael Hebron, Andrew Getson, James Seickmann and many others. Zack will be teaching for Green Hill this summer. “My approach to the game is to make it as simple, fun and pain free as possible to protect the longevity of the game.
